headline: Norse Atlantic suspends flights and faces bankruptcy risk
summary: Norse Atlantic has halted all flight operations and is seeking urgent financing to avoid bankruptcy, citing sector-wide turmoil.
why: The airline industry is highly sensitive to geopolitical conflicts and rising operational costs.

impacts.name: Norse Atlantic
impacts.why: Bankruptcy warnings and operational halts are severely negative for equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Operational suspension and insolvency risk are critical indicators of financial distress for an airline.
